tcp_flags_policy: Original ACK preserved; PSH remains only on last child of a resegmented packet; no original SYN/FIN/RST packet is split.
timestamp_policy: All children retain the original timestamp and are inserted consecutively before the next original record.
ipv4_id_policy: Original IPv4 ID retained on all children; original DF remains set, and no IP fragmentation is introduced.
reconstruction: Copy global PCAP header. For each output mapping, take original frame unchanged if selected_original; otherwise concatenate its header up to original_payload_offset_from_frame_start with original_payload_range [start,end) of its TCP payload. Apply edits in order. Preserve original record timestamp and set captured/original lengths to output_frame_length.
